messages:
maria-partnerships: quick sync — planning joint marketplace listing + SI co-sell for the HW bundle. goal: coordinated lead flow, clear ROE, and a fast demo program. two-week launch target.
kevin-sales: solid. i'll kick off a pipeline sweep and flag top 150 AC accounts. will post claims tonight.
arya-si-eng: we can staff a rotation for demos. please tag intake leads with `si-integration` so we can filter.
chris-product: proposal: SI claim only after a qualified discovery or demo booked. prevents claimspam.
sophie-gobiz: i'll draft the marketplace one-liner and plans for listing assets. need SKU list + expected fulfillment window from HW partner.
peter-hw-partner: i'll share SKU CSV and monthly quota by EOD (PKG-342, PKG-343). also sending sample request form.
maria-partnerships: routing rules suggestion: 1) if Redwood AE already owns account -> AE retains ownership; 2) if account originated from marketplace lead -> marketplace team owns initial nurture; 3) if SI has an active POC or signed NDA -> SI gets claim after confirmation. escalate conflicts to @sophie-gobiz.
kevin-sales: how do we mark claims programmatically? can we add a claim_reason and source fields in the shared CSV?
maria-partnerships: yes — shared format in /shared/si-handovers.csv:
```
acct_id,acct_name,owner,region,engagement_stage,si_interest,claim_source,claim_reason
```
arya-si-eng: SLA ask for SI: respond to claims within 48h with next-step (demo scheduled / more info). if no response, ownership reverts to AE.
sophie-gobiz: agree to 48h. also require SI to onboard in the sandbox within 5 business days before claiming production work. tag demos with `demo-sandbox:true`.
chris-product: add a guardrail: no direct marketplace announcements naming customers until joint comms review. legal/comms signoff required.
deploy-bot: created calendar: "HW bundle SI intake" Fri 10:30am PT — attendees maria-partnerships, kevin-sales, arya-si-eng, sophie-gobiz.
peter-hw-partner: noted on calendars. shipping windows look good for Apr samples.
kevin-sales: action items: pipeline sweep tonight, i'll upload claims to shared CSV and ping for conflicts.
arya-si-eng: action: prep demo rotation schedule and sandbox credentials.
sophie-gobiz: action: marketplace listing draft + SLA doc. will circulate draft by tomorrow.
maria-partnerships: i'll open GH issue to track tasks and flag blockers. thanks everyone — we'll reconvene after the sweep to resolve claim collisions. :thumbsup:
